chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim, who said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

Whoever has intercourse with his wife after the completion of the waiting period is given the hadd punishment; but if he has intercourse with her before the completion of the waiting period, his intercourse with her counts as a return to her.

key_terms.انْقِضَاءِ الْعِدَّةِ: the completion of the waiting period after divorce
key_terms.جُلِدَ الْحَدَّ: the prescribed legal punishment is carried out by flogging
key_terms.رَجْعَةً: revocation of divorce and return to the wife within the waiting period

ai.seo_question: Does intercourse with a divorced wife during her ʿiddah count as rajʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a man and his divorced wife during and after the waiting period (ʿiddah). Intercourse before the end of the ʿiddah is treated as rajʿah (revocation and return), while intercourse after its completion is treated as a punishable unlawful act.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5004 - Narrated by Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim, who said that Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever has intercourse with his wife after the completion of her waiting period ('iddah) is to be subjected to the prescribed punishment (hadd).
However, if he has intercourse with her before the completion of her waiting period, that act is considered a return (reconciliation) to her."
